summary: 3D tea house time-management game on an Istanbul quay, v2 with ferry rushes, tea freshness, tavla regulars and gull thieves, built by Claude Sonnet 5.5 · İstanbul rıhtımında 3D çay ocağı zaman yönetimi oyunu, v2'de vapur saati kalabalığı, taze çay, tavlacı müdavimler ve simit kapan martılar, Claude Sonnet 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Four items on five stations: tea brews in the semaver, simit warms in the oven, coffee boils over if left, dirty glasses go to the sink
v2: ferry rushes from day 3 (a horn warns 8 s ahead, then 2-3 parties arrive at once), tea that goes stale, tavla regulars who ask for refills and gulls that steal simit unless shooed
v2: Play goes straight into day 1 with coach marks; fact cards, tea house ranks and the kitten on the shop and summary screens
Seven 3-minute days with a coin target and 1-3 stars, a shop between days, then an endless shift
The ?auto bot plays with the same actions as a player and finishes 7/7 days; 60 fps at 1280x720 with 27 draw calls

social.headline: Run a tiny Istanbul tea house: brew tea, warm simit, serve every table in time · Küçük bir çay ocağı işlet: çay demle, simit ısıt, her masaya yetiş
